description_zh:
没有怪物，但要真实地活下去：吃饱、喝足、保暖、打猎，撑过 3 天！答题赚「知识点」，买装备、学知识，让你活得更轻松。

【详细玩法】
游戏目标：活 3 天
游戏开始：开始时可以带 5 样东西
游戏模式：常规荒野 / 凛冬荒野 / 炙热沙漠
游戏操作：鼠标转视角 · WASD 移动 · E 砍树 / 采集 / 钓鱼 / 捕猎 / 喝水 / 添柴 · 重燃 · F 吃东西 · G 喝水 · C 合成建造 · B 营地商店 · Q 答题赚知识点 · T 扎营（需帐篷） · 右下角是地图，暴风雪时会变模糊
description_en:
No monsters, but you still need to survive for real: eat, drink, stay warm, hunt, and make it through 3 days! Answer quiz questions to earn Knowledge Points — buy gear, learn knowledge, and make survival easier.

[Detailed Gameplay]
Objective: Survive for 3 days
Start: Choose 5 items to bring at the beginning
Game modes: Regular Wilderness / Winter Wilderness / Scorching Desert
Controls: Mouse to look around · WASD to move · E to chop trees / gather / fish / hunt / drink water / add firewood · F to eat · G to drink · C to craft and build · B for the camp shop · Q to answer questions and earn Knowledge Points · T to set up camp (requires a tent) · Map at the bottom right, which blurs during blizzards
